about: The dashboard's web analytics (agentcake/api/web.py): rows_max, how many of its top rows by all, by Agent and by Human sessions a table (Paths, and each dimension of Sources, Devices and Geography) returns, together; rows_shown, how many the dashboard shows before Show all (PostHog's tables show 10); fill_sessions, how many sessions recorded before cake.js sent their source one request fills in from what was kept of them (web_props.fill): the rest wait for the next request. trend_interval: the interval the Trends chart counts each range by, PostHog's web analytics' default for it (frontend/src/lib/utils/dateFilters.ts dateMapping: Today by hour, the last 7 and 30 days by day, All time by month).
